title: StateMachine commits to "At End" transition prematurely
body: ### Tested versions Tested on 4.5.1 and current master. ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9144) - AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 63.91 GiB memory ### Issue description I have a nested StateMachine for when the player is carrying an unconscious enemy. This StateMachine exits with an animation of the player dropping the enemy to the ground, then standing. If the "crouch" button is pressed during this animation, then the state transitions via sync into a similar animation with a crouching end. The issue is that unless both transitions to end are given a lower priority than the sync transitions between the two animations, the choice to use the end transition is already locked in, and the sync transitions never trigger. This shouldn't really happen, since the sync transitions' conditions become true much before the animations' end, whereas the "at end" transitions' condition, practically speaking, only becomes true either when when the state ends or starts blending to end. This problem occurs with immediate or sync transitions, with or without reset. At End is just selected too early. ### Steps to reproduce I've prepared an MRP with a label that changes its name to reflect state. 1. Open MRP. 2. Play. 3. Press spacebar to transition out of "start". 4. Press spacebar during "stand" to try to switch to "crouch" via sync. Observe that it failed. 5. Observe transition to "End" at end. 6. Change sync transition's priority to 0. 7. Repeat steps 2-5, observing that it worked. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [statemachine-attend.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24215063/statemachine-attend.zip)
